Becca Lin (CSM): quick weekly: sending p95/p99 split by route+model (streaming vs sync) for Axiom Labs. noticed 1 short tail spike Thu 18:10 UTC.
Hari Desai (SRE): 7d snapshot:
- chat.completions @ rw-chat-4: streaming p95=210ms p99=640ms; sync p95=370ms p99=980ms.
- rerank @ rw-rank-1: streaming p95=185ms p99=500ms; sync p95=260ms p99=720ms.
- embed.text @ rw-embed-2: sync p95=46ms p99=125ms.
Elliot Park (Client): we had a short demo at 18:15 and noticed a lag — matches p99 bump.
Hari Desai (SRE): autoscaler saw a 28% concurrency jump 18:05-18:25 UTC; queue peaked 65, scale-up latency ~42s. small canary (rw-small-alpha) had ~10% traffic then; its p99 sync ~1.3s.
Marta Ruiz (Onboarding): noted — some trial workspaces still hit rw-small-alpha for canary testing during demos. will adjust schedule.
Becca Lin (CSM): actions: 1) Hari to cap canary to <3% during 14:00-02:00 UTC; 2) Marta to coordinate canary windows with Axiom; 3) Becca to run a 20-min streaming enablement showing concurrency benefits.
Hari Desai (SRE): I'll also add a 30s synthetic check on chat route and watch p99 after the routing tweak.
Elliot Park (Client): appreciated. target p99 <750ms for our upcoming vendor demo.
Becca Lin (CSM): I'll post updated p95/p99 snapshot after changes. closing unless tail persists.
